messages:
Kate (People Ops): Putting together a tiny 'first-week + 30/60/90' checklist specifically for new managers. Super compact. Can you quick-scan and add any must-haves?

Marco (Hiring Manager): Please include a short preboard list (forms to finish before Day 1) and a one-slide stakeholder map due by Day 5.

Eleni (Eng Manager): Ops items: staging RBAC by default, prod access via request + security review, oncall shadow within 10 days, and if applicable request Redwood Dedicated/GPU quota early.

Kate (People Ops): Draft one-pager below (copy-paste into offer packet):
- PREBOARD:
  - [ ] HR forms + benefits link completed
  - [ ] Google account & MFA verified
  - [ ] Pick buddy & timezone preferences

- DAY 1 MICRO AGENDA:
  - 09:00 People Ops intro (paperwork + benefits)
  - 10:00 Tech access check (Slack, GitHub, Redwood Console viewer)
  - 11:00 Team hello + schedule 1:1s with directs
  - EOD: block daily focus time and add 30/60/90 template to calendar

- FIRST WEEK MUSTS:
  - Meet every direct report (30m) using 30/60/90 prompts
  - Share 1-slide stakeholder map by Day 5
  - Verify CI/CD + deploy bot access
  - If oncall: schedule oncall shadow within 10 days
  - Complete 7-day pulse (accounts, clarity, blockers)

- 2-WEEK GUIDELINES:
  - Interviews <=2/day; avoid >4 hours meetings/day; block focus time
  - Staging RBAC default; prod via security approval

- 30/60/90 PROMPTS (brief):
  - 30d: map org & stakeholders, unblock 2 priority issues, start interviewing
  - 60d: lead a postmortem or planning session, propose process improvement
  - 90d: present Q+1 plan with 2 measurable team KPIs; update IC onboarding

Rae (Onboarding): We'll auto-add the 7-day pulse to HR reminders and attach this to the offer packet.

Marco (Hiring Manager): Add hiring expectation: candidate scorecards within 48h, debrief within 72h.

Eleni (Eng Manager): Please add link to model catalog & deploy policy if relevant for their work. Also request Dedicated/GPU quota early.

Kate (People Ops): Great points 44d I'll fold edits and publish the one-pager tonight. OnboardBot: new-manager-onepager copied to /docs/onboarding/manager-quickstart.md

WelcomeBot: Template saved. If anything else, drop it here and I'll iterate.
